reason: The new `EmailValidator`, which includes `BlockedEmail.should_block?` (lib/validators/email_validator.rb:183), runs on every `email_changed?` save (app/models/user.rb:106), but `change_email` (app/controllers/users_controller.rb:265-286) only checks for an existing user before creating the token and sending mail to the address. On confirmation, `EmailToken.confirm`'s `user.save!` (app/models/email_token.rb:53) raises `RecordInvalid`, which is rescued and returns nil (email_token.rb:57-58), so the user gets a generic failure with no reason; the domain blacklist already failed this way, and the patch extends it to blocked addresses.
